title: Construction of normalized Weil Hom and geometric comparison data
statement: Fix D,C,E,S,W,X,Y,f,cf,cy,cx with the same geometric and coefficient hypotheses as the specified chosen-duality exchange. There exists Data D C S.closure W X Y f cf cy cx: full normalized Hom lifts at X,Y and the point, the tensor-unit-normalized coefficient pair, the compact-support compositor and projection isomorphisms with their specified carrier maps. No exchange transformation, naturality, chosen structure right adjoints, or OrdinaryMaps assertion is included.

source.place: Construction/domain part of item DAG Steps 1,4,5; cor-coef-verdier-weil-equivariance evaluation and coefficient-unit paragraphs; thm-sf-verdier-exchange Step 1 composition.

proof.text: First check the domains, before transposing any map. For separated finite-type $T=X,Y$, [cor-coef-integral-internal-hom] puts the internal Hom of any two integral constructible objects back in $D^b_c(T,\mathcal O_E)$. Pullback and completed tensor preserve that category by [lem-pur-integral-operations-preserve-constructible]. The rational and common-stage object formulas of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] therefore define these three operations on all pairs in $\mathcal C_T$. Compact support preserves it by [lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible] and the field-stage object formulas of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]; ordinary pullback and direct image form an adjunction between these bounded categories by [fix-prop-adjunctions](1). Finally [cor-coef-verdier-weil-equivariance] supplies the canonical constructible exceptional adjunctions on pairs, including the structure morphisms. The chosen $J_T$ already has values in the pair category by hypothesis. Thus $\omega_T$, $A=R\mathcal Hom_Y(Rf_!M,\omega_Y)$, $f^*A$, $M\otimes^Lf^*A$, $G_f\omega_Y$, $R\mathcal Hom_X(M,G_f\omega_Y)$, and its $Rf_*$ all lie in the claimed bounded constructible categories. No site-perfectness of $M$ or ambient exceptional adjoint is used.

The tensor--Hom adjunction of [sk-def-sf-operations](i) restricts to the bounded categories because Step 1 gives both functors there. Its naturality is in the first variable as well as in the other two. It also restricts to pairs with their standard Hom structure: [lem-pod-derived-automorphism-hom-evaluation] applies to the geometric-Frobenius scheme isomorphism and states that its evaluation-defined Hom comparison preserves transposition, at rational and common-stage coefficients on exactly these integral-Hom domains. Explicitly a map $b:K\otimes^LL\to N$ is a pair map precisely when
$$b(\theta_K\otimes\theta_L)\mu=\theta_N P(b),$$
where $P$ is Frobenius pullback and $\mu:P(K\otimes L)\simeq PK\otimes PL$. Transpose this equality using that lemma's formula $c\,P(b^\sharp)$ for the transpose of $P(b)\mu^{-1}$. Naturality of the tensor--Hom bijection and cancellation of the isomorphism $\theta_K$ turn it into
$$b^\sharp\theta_L=\bigl(R\mathcal Hom(\theta_K^{-1},\theta_N)c\bigr)P(b^\sharp).$$
This is exactly the pair-morphism equation for $L\to R\mathcal Hom(K,N)$. The same calculation backwards gives the inverse restriction. Thus the tensor--Hom Hom bijection, its unit and evaluation counit are the original ones on carrier objects and apply to the chosen $\omega_Y$ just as to any other Weil pair.

Construct the tensor-unit-normalized coefficient pair at the model point. Lift the specified support compositor and projection isomorphisms using normalized Frobenius comparisons, for the supplied W. At field coefficients every second input is in the projection domain. Their carrier maps are exactly composition_carrier and projection_carrier. Combine these with the normalized Hom lifts of the previous steps to give Nonempty Data; no exchange naturality or chosen structure adjunctions occur.
